//: This file configures how Certify The Web discovers and monitors Azure App Service Managed Certificates
Optional: Limit discovery to specific resource groups. Remove or leave empty to scan all resource groups
Authentication Method 1: Service Principal (recommended for production)
Create an Azure AD App Registration and grant it Reader role on your subscription
Authentication Method 2: Managed Identity (for Azure-hosted Management Hub)
Use this if running Certify Management Hub in Azure. Comment out service principal settings above.
Authentication Method 3: Default Azure Credential (for development)
Leave all authentication properties empty/null to use Azure CLI or Visual Studio credentials
